chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Aban ibn Taghlub who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The Divine Authority (was) before the creation, and (is) with the creation, and (will be) after the creation.'

key_terms.الحجة: al-Hujjah — the Divine Proof or Authority; the Imam who is God's proof to humankind
key_terms.الخلق: al-Khalq — creation; collectively all created beings, but especially the human community

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the Divine Authority (Hujjah) existing before, with, and after creation?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) declares that the Hujjah (Divine Authority, i.e., the Imam or Proof of God) has always existed — before, during, and after all of creation. This hadith establishes that the earth is never without a Hujjah, a foundational doctrine of Shia Imamology. The original audience, students of Aban ibn Taghlub, would have understood this as affirming that God's guidance to humanity through an authoritative Imam is eternal and continuous, not limited to any particular era.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Barqy, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Aban Bin Taghlub who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Divine Authority (was) before the people, and (is) with the people, and (will be) after the people’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi from Khalaf ibn Hammad from ’Aban ibn Taghlib from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“A person with Divine authority is before the people, with the people and after the people.”
